listing.name: SDL Sopwith
listing.summary: Fly SDL Sopwith's biplane through classic aerial combat.

steps.title: Start the managed Windows game
steps.instruction: The official Windows package includes the game. Choose Play after installation.

steps.title: Install the upstream Mac app
steps.instruction: Choose the ZIP for your Mac processor, extract its DMG and copy SDL Sopwith.app into Applications. The inspected Intel build needs macOS 13 and the Apple silicon build needs macOS 15. Keep your SDL Sopwith settings and high scores before replacing the Mac app.

warnings: This project has not been verified for play through Portcove.
You and upstream own the Mac setup, updates and preference files.

presentation.manual_preparation: No original game data is required. Portcove installs and updates the portable runtime. SDL Sopwith normally stores settings and high scores in its upstream preference folder, outside Portcove backups. Declared in-folder fallback files are preserved. Runtime rollback does not roll back those settings.
